paper_scope: The paper analyzes anomalous diffusion in subrecoil-laser-cooled atoms using the rate-induced Levy walk (RILW) and inhomogeneous random walk (IRW) models, with a velocity-dependent fluorescence rate R(v) proportional to |v|^alpha. It derives the asymptotic MSD scaling exponent gamma(alpha) and validates it numerically. The selected cluster focuses on the normalized MSD scaling ratio M(r)=MSD(t)/MSD(t_ref)=r^gamma for alpha=2 and alpha=4, using the analytic RILW model.
